list: The official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. 28 are hidden on PlayStation until earned.
sourceNote: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as Exophase and PSNProfiles published it before this bounty opened. Every guide below is written for this entry in our own words, built from the official description, and says plainly where a place or step is not pinned down yet: the game released 2026-11-19 and no guide below was checked in the game. Sources per trophy: Exophase for the official list, PSNProfiles for PSN's progress target where one exists, and our own advice from the description.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum pops the moment the last one lands, so work the roadmap in order and leave nothing to a second playthrough.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It unlocks as you play the story, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Missable only if the mission cannot be replayed: finish it when it appears and do not skip it.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the main story. Missable only if chapters cannot be replayed: do not rush past it.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same as Chapter 1: play the story in order. The name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep the main story moving; side content can wait until after the story if you prefer, but chapter trophies cannot be earned out of order.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale. If the game offers chapter replay, a missed chapter trophy can be recovered there; if not, it is gone for this playthrough.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. This is the gold story trophy: it pops when the story ends. Play the finale when it appears; there is no way to earn it before the story is done.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. Story missions unlock in order, so play through the story until it appears. Treat every named mission trophy as missable until the game proves missions replayable.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist mission: it appears as the story reaches it. Heist missions often have setup steps, so follow the mission prompts and do not abandon it halfway.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. Story mission, in order. If you are chasing the platinum in one run, never skip a story mission when it is offered.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. Story mission, in order. The exact location and steps are not pinned down yet: follow the in-game mission marker when it appears.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown, at the Vice City International Airport. Story mission, in order. Expect an airport-set action mission; the exact steps are not pinned down yet.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story mission, in order. The name suggests a large set-piece; follow the mission prompts and keep a save before it if the game allows.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the gold grind trophy: it counts story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration together. Use the checklist to clear every category, then check the in-game completion stat for what is left. It cannot be missed, only left unfinished.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts: jumps, airtime, near misses and similar feats. Stunts count across free roam and missions, so they pile up naturally if you drive fast and jump often. To grind them, repeat jumps and ramps around Vice City. Progress is cumulative and never missable.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (250 stunts) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting, drone races and one more. One try each is enough, so sample everything early and tick them off here.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (9 activity types) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each challenge's scoring first, then repeat until gold. This is a skill grind, not a luck one: steady aim beats rushing, and every challenge can be retried.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (42 challenges) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is a separate race, so work through them one by one. Drone races can be retried, so a loss costs nothing but time.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (14 locations) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different races count, not repeat wins of the same one, so keep entering new events. Any race type counts; pick the ones you are best at first.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (20 races) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take the challenge. Fishing challenges can be retried, so learn the timing and try again if you lose.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Visit an arcade, pick any game and play it to the end. One completion is enough, so choose the easiest game on offer.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Andy is one of the stranger contacts with a mission strand: play his missions as they appear until the strand ends. Finish the strand before the story ends, in case strands lock after the finale.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Same as Andy: play Kenton's strand as it appears and finish it before the story ends, in case strands lock after the finale.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Same as Andy and Kenton: play Billy's strand as it appears and finish it before the story ends.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear around the state with their own mission chains; finish 8 whole strands. Work them alongside the story, and do not leave them all until after the finale in case they lock.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (8 strands) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Same as the other stranger contacts: play Randy's strand as it appears and finish it before the story ends.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Same as the other stranger contacts: play Tyrone's strand as it appears and finish it before the story ends.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are scattered around the state; visit each and meditate once. Spots stay available after the story, so this is safe to clean up late.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (18 spots) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt targets one special animal; follow his strand until the hunt is offered, then track and take it down. The exact animal and location are not pinned down yet.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found around Leonida; collect full sets, three of them. Cards stay available after the story, so gather them as you explore and finish the sets during cleanup.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (3 sets) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is an in-game activity tied to places around the state; visit 100 of them. This is a pure exploration count, so fold it into your Leonida tour and finish the remainder during cleanup.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (100 locations) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives across activities and free roam; they add up as you play. Check the challenges menu for the easiest ones and clear them during cleanup.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (50 challenges) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Do it when a partner is available to ride with you: raise heat, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. Partner moments may be story-limited, so try it the first time a partner is free-roaming with you.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Keep the heat the whole way: rob, move to the next shop fast, and do not let the stars clear between robberies. Try it the first time a partner is free-roaming with you, in case partner moments are story-limited.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles count when you first find or drive them, so variety is the goal: try every car, bike, boat and aircraft you see. It pairs naturally with exploring all 52 areas.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (100 vehicles) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus where enemies cluster, then take them down fast before it ends. Retry freely: find a busy fight and try again until five fall in one focus.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at the Vice City International Airport: leave VCIA in a way no timetable planned, such as taking off in an aircraft without a flight. The exact method is not pinned down yet; try it at the airport and watch for the pop. One-time spots like this are best tried the first time you are at the airport.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos, the tanks. Raise enough heat that the military sends a Rhino, then handle it: steal it, destroy it, or survive it. The exact trigger is not pinned down yet; high wanted levels in open ground are the usual way tanks appear.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again; detection is what fails it, not the robbery itself.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Each vault is a full robbery: get in, crack the vault, get out with the heat on. Plan an escape route before you start, and repeat until five are done.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (5 vaults) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, take its cargo, then lose the heat. Trucks roam the state, so watch the roads and strike when one is isolated.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Visit every named area on the map; the count tracks as you go. Pair it with the WAiNK locations, meditation spots and vehicle discoveries to cover the state in one sweep.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (52 areas) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own operations around the state; hit one per gang. Learn which operation belongs to which gang before you strike, so none is wasted.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (9 gangs) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. A calm one: no heat, no timer, just the beach.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive out through the glass in a showroom car, the way the old games taught us. Pick a showroom, pick a car, and leave through the front.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. One full game with a proper follow-through is enough. It also counts toward trying every activity type.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This reads as a story or partner moment rather than a grind, so it likely pops from a story beat with your partner. Play the story and partner content; the exact beat is not pinned down yet.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices: PSN tracks them up to 500. Choices happen across story and side content, so they pile up as you play. Nothing to grind here, just play and choose; the count is cumulative.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (500 choices) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. Fail something, then succeed at the same thing on the very next try. It is a retry-gated moment: the game notices the second attempt landing.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. An easter-egg style event somewhere in Leonida: the description reads like a surprise encounter. Explore odd places and keep an eye out; the exact event is not pinned down yet.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Line up a slow pass, swing as you pass, and keep moving. Retry freely until one connects.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (target) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; launder them through contacts to turn them into clean cash. Keep robbing and laundering until $250,000 is clean.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles ($250,000) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buying anything counts: clothes, food, gear, ammo. Spend as you play and it lands on its own; during cleanup, buy big-ticket items to close the gap.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles ($100,000) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale around the state; buy each as you find it. You will need the cash, so pair this with the Marked Bills laundering and shop spending.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (8 garages) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, then register them in the app. Ten different vehicles is the count; variety helps, and it pairs with discovering 100 vehicles.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official list) · PSNProfiles (10 vehicles) · own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game
